component.name: RSSH
component.summary: Modern cross-platform SSH and SFTP terminal client

description.p: RSSH is a cross-platform SSH terminal and SFTP file management client built with Rust and Tauri.
This Flatpak wrapper fetches the signed upstream release package from helloshu/auto-builds at install time via extra-data and runs it inside the GNOME WebKitGTK sandbox.
